cohort: 23,272 primiparous women who vaginally delivered a cephalic singleton gestation at or after 34 weeks gestation between 2011 and 2020
finding: Among primiparous women, VAVD did not increase the risk of OASIS compared to SVD.
mod_finding: This study found that vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery (VAVD) in primiparous women did not increase the risk of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS) compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD).
